verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a broad programmatic surface: a 174-path Developer API (transactions, bills, virtual cards via Vault, spend controls, custom records), plus a CLI and MCP covering approvals, reimbursements, cards, funds and travel. However, no source claims full UI parity. The vendor itself notes that bill approvals are not yet available via MCP and points users to the UI or a separate Approvals API. Developer app creation and MCP access restrictions are also documented only as dashboard (UI) steps. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment or coverage mapping, programmatic setup of apps and admin configuration, uniform coverage across channels (e.g., bill approvals in MCP), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
